title: Syn-QA2: Evaluating False Assumptions in Long-tail Questions with Synthetic QA Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of binary (Yes/No) outputs from language models in a false assumption detection task to identify if the models disproportionately favor one answer over another (e.g., a bias towards answering 'No', or a 'false assumption bias' where the model persistently assumes a question has a false premise regardless of its actual content).
